title: Conference on Blood and Blood Components Standards in the Indian Pharmacopoeia 2026: A Step Forward in Strengthening Blood Transfusion Services in India
bodyHtml:
The Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission, Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, in collaboration with Delhi Pharmaceutical Sciences and Research University, New Delhi, is organizing a focused scientific conference aimed at strengthening blood transfusion services through updated pharmacopoeial standards and regulatory alignment.

Date: 11 March 2026 (Wednesday)

Time: 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM
Venue: Delhi Pharmaceutical Sciences and Research University, New Delhi
Registration Fee: ₹ 590/- (including 18% GST)
Registration Deadline: 6 March 2026

Key Topics:

• Indian Pharmacopoeia 2026 – An Overview
• Blood and Blood Components: Regulatory Landscape
• Pharmacopoeial Standards – Technical Specifications and Quality Control
• Rational Use of Blood and Blood Components
• Skilling Manpower

Expert speakers from:

• Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission
• Drug Regulatory Authority
• Transfusion Medicine
• WHO
Who Should Attend (Delhi/NCR):
• Blood Centre Medical Officers & Technical Staff
• QC/QA Managers
• Centres performing irradiation of Blood Components
• Licensing and Compliance Coordinators
• Regulatory Professionals

Join us in advancing standardized, safe, and quality-assured blood transfusion practices across India.

Scan the QR code to register. Seats are limited.
